candidates.change_summary: Replace the final transfer to owner with sending remaining balance to msg.sender instead of owner, changing who receives leftover funds after call.
Replace the external call to target.call with a staticcall, preventing the target from receiving ETH and changing resulting balance behavior.
Replace the conditional revert on failed call with ignoring the failure (no revert), allowing go to continue even if target.call fails which changes final balances.
Replace the transfer to owner with a call to owner using gas-forwarding call, which may change whether transfer succeeds and thus observable balance outcome.
Replace the target address with the zero address, causing the forwarded call to behave differently and affecting final balances.
